questions.description: Recommended exclusions listed; add or remove.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Out of scope: running transcription/diarization, notebooklm DB/package imports, editing transcript text, multi-file timelines, NotebookLM network calls, migrating the existing Rich TUI to Textual.
